text:
Leah: Argos (hardware partner) reached out -> want Redwood listed in Argentina marketplace next month. Theyre requesting reserved GPU capacity, joint go-live PR, and an SI onboarding window. Who owns marketplace approvals?
Tom: Ill take marketplace approvals. Need SKU list + expected steady & peak usage.
Diego (Argos): Thanks. SKUs: `redwood-edge-arg-p40`, `redwood-edge-arg-p40-provision`. Steady: 8k tokens/s, peak: 25k tokens/s first 10 days. Also need HSM/KMS support for keys in AR region.
Vivian: legal/security note: Argentina requires explicit data residency statements for some telco customers. Well need a data flow diagram and a short DP addendum. Diego, can you share any local SI requirements?
Diego (Argos): AndesSystems is our SI. Theyll need test creds + a sandbox for one week. Also they want a short swagger of the management API for autoscaling hooks.
Tom: Ops checklist I'm planning: 1) submit quota request to marketplace 2) reserve GPU pool 3) confirm HSM availability 4) smoke test with AndesSystems. Will open ticket now.
Leah: timeline? Partner wants listing date by Mar 10 and press on Mar 15. We should aim for internal signoff a week before listing.
Tom: created ticket #MP-9821 with initial numbers:
```
region: ar-central-1
resource: gpu.p40
initial_quota: 30
burst_quota: 80
justification: Argos partner launch + SI onboarding
```
I CC'd @infra and @kms-team.
Vivian: Ill prep the DP addendum and coordinate with security for PII checks. Also need to review their SLA text for the marketplace listing.
Diego (Argos): We can share the SI runbook and management API doc. Uploading to partner portal: https://partners.argos.example/redwood/argentina.
ops-bot: Reservation request created: res-arg-0047, status: pending capacity confirmation.
Leah: can we provision a limited sandbox account `redwood-arg-test` with 5 concurrent instances for AndesSystems? Tom?
Tom: yes, provisioning now. Will share one-time link in ticket and set 5-day expiry.
Diego (Argos): appreciated. AndesSystems will run a preflight on Thu. If all good, theyll request full capacity ramp on go-live.
Vivian: Marketing wants 2-sentence blurb + 2 compliance bullets. Leah, can you draft copy by Wed?
Leah: yes, will draft and post in #marketing-partners.
Tom: noted. Next steps recap: Tom -> quota & reservation; Vivian -> legal + security addendum; Diego -> SI runbook + API swagger; Leah -> announcement copy + PR coordination.
Diego (Argos): were targeting marketplace QA this Friday. Will update here once done. :thumbsup: 
Tom: Ill update ticket MP-9821 with reservation confirmation and paste link here.
Leah: thanks all if anything blocks, schedule 20m sync.
ops-bot: Ticket MP-9821 updated: capacity pending confirmation from provider.
